name: smwgraphics-slot-machine
title: Slot Machine
description:
A wacky replacement for Customizable Reznors , made by KevinM. You may remember this sprite from my KLDC 2021 level, Wario in Japan. Great for a wacky boss fight. In order to use this sprite replacement, you will need patch the Reznor Fireball Flag to make use of the big fireball graphic. After that, you need to download the Customizable Reznor sprite, and then, replace the CustomReznor.asm with the one that is included with this graphic.

Credits to No Body the Dragon. Custom palette included.
